name: Hextar Global Berhad
overview: Hextar Global 今年提出多元化计划，拟将业务扩展至物业发展、建筑及物业管理，并通过合资公司 Hextar Siera 与 PKNS 合作开发混合用途项目。同时，公司拟收购若干公司（涉及农业相关业务），但收购条件期限多次延长，且其中一项收购（PKF 60%股权）已被排除。此外，公司完成出售三块农业土地，作价 RM13,750,000。
overview_en: Hextar Global proposed a diversification this year to include property development, construction, and property investment and management, and plans a mixed-use development project through a joint venture company, Hextar Siera, with PKNS. Concurrently, the company proposed acquisitions of several companies (involving agriculture-related businesses), but the conditional periods have been extended multiple times, and one acquisition (60% stake in PKF) has been excluded.

segments.name: 农业
segments.note: 拟收购农业相关公司，同时出售农业土地。
segments.note_en: Proposed acquisitions of agriculture-related companies while disposing of agricultural land.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 将拟议收购的條件期限进一步延长至2026年12月31日。
actions.text_en: Further extended the conditional period for the proposed acquisitions to 31 December 2026.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 拟收购 PKFT 12,300,000 股股份，并修订收购条款，将 PKF 60,000,000 股股份（现金代价 RM65.50 million）排除在拟议收购之外。
actions.text_en: Proposed acquisition of 12,300,000 shares in PKFT, with revised terms excluding the proposed acquisition of 60,000,000 shares in PKF for a cash consideration of RM65.50 million.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 将拟议收购的條件期限延长3个月至2026年9月22日。
actions.text_en: Extended the conditional period for the proposed acquisitions by 3 months to 22 September 2026.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 以现金 RM13,750,000 出售三块农业土地，交易已完成。
actions.text_en: Disposed of three agricultural land parcels for a total cash consideration of RM13,750,000; the disposal was completed.

segments.name: 集团 / Group
segments.note: 拟多元化至物业发展、建筑及物业管理，并成立合资公司开发混合用途项目。
segments.note_en: Proposed diversification into property development, construction, and property investment and management, and established a joint venture for a mixed-use development project.

actions.title: MULTIPLE PROPOSALS
actions.text: 就合资公司 Hextar Siera 与 PKNS 的购地协议，将余额订金 RM12.80 million 的支付期限延长至2026年10月30日。
actions.text_en: Extended the payment period for the balance deposit of RM12.80 million under the Development Land SPA between Hextar Siera and PKNS to 30 October 2026.

model_changes.title: MULTIPLE PROPOSALS
model_changes.text: 并成立合资公司开发混合用途项目。
model_changes.text_en: Proposed diversification into property development, construction, property investment and management, and establishment of a joint venture for a mixed-use development project.
